Thick, fluffy pancakes for a slow weekend breakfast. Makes about 10.

== Ingredients ==
* 250 g plain flour
* 2 tablespoons sugar
* 1 teaspoon baking powder
* 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
* 1/2 teaspoon salt
* 400 ml buttermilk
* 2 eggs
* 40 g melted butter, plus more for the pan

== Method ==
# Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
# In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
# Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir with a fork until just combined. Lumps are good. Rest for 10 minutes.
# Heat a heavy pan over medium-low heat and brush it with butter. Pour in about 60 ml of batter per pancake.
# Cook until bubbles appear across the surface and the edges look dry, about 2 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 minute more.
# Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest.

== Tips ==
* No buttermilk? Stir 1 tablespoon of lemon juice into 400 ml milk and leave it for 5 minutes.
* The first pancake is always a test pancake.
* Discard from a [[Sourdough starter]] can replace up to 100 ml of the buttermilk.
